nmap.description: Discover services on one pinned host

nuclei.description: Run configured Nuclei templates. Adaptive mode uses observed Nmap products/HTTPX technologies to select HTTP template tags; unknown products use native automatic detection. HTTPX first can improve selection. Matches are unverified.

playwright.description: Observe browser page and capture screenshot without form submission

web_discover.description: Passive reconnaissance: GET one seed document plus robots.txt and sitemap.xml, then extract in-scope links, forms, scripts and documented routes into web_routes.

http_request.description: Send one bounded, rate-limited HTTP request to an in-scope URL. Method GET/HEAD is non-destructive; POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE require exact human approval. The response is reduced to a structured trace with deterministic signatures (SQL/NoSQL errors, reflected markup, traversal markers, sensitive data); a signature is not proof by itself.

idor.description: Execute a named configured scenario once: GET owner and other identity, compare responses and verify against private-object ground truth. Results and verification are already in idor_findings; evaluate them in reflection, never call this tool again to evaluate its existing result.

api_discover.description: GET one observed API endpoint or listed document probe, parse OpenAPI GET routes and actual collection records. No schema examples as object data.

scenario.description: Build a scenario from a listed scenario_candidates name. Three GET requests validate two supplied sessions and owner private content; requires identity context. Produces an idor_scenarios name for the idor tool.
